title: On the Turán number of the directed path
summary: In this note we determine the maximum number of arcs in a digraph on $n$ vertices that does not contain a length-$k$ directed path $\overrightarrow{P}_{k+1}$ for $n \geq 50k^6$. This improves a theorem of Zhou and Li [$\textit{Graphs Combin.}$ 39(3), 2023] who proved the result with a superexponential threshold on $n$.

title: Hypergraph Erdős--Rogers functions with consecutive clique sizes
summary: For integers \(k\le s<t\), let \(f^{(k)}_{s,t}(n)\) denote the largest integer \(m\) such that every \(n\)-vertex \(K_t^{(k)}\)-free \(k\)-graph contains a set of \(m\) vertices spanning no copy of \(K_s^{(k)}\). We give an affirmative answer to a problem of Conlon, Fox and Sudakov by proving that, for every fixed \(s\ge4\), \[ f^{(4)}_{s,s+1}(n)=(\log n)^{o(1)} . \] The key input is a new \(3\)-uniform estimate: for every fixed \(s\ge3\), \(f^{(3)}_{s,s+1}(n)=O(\frac{\log n}{\log\log n})\). This improves the logarithmic upper bound of Dudek and Mubayi. The proof combines hypergraph containers with a probabilistic construction. As a further consequence, for every fixed \(k\ge5\) there exists a constant $C_k>0$ such that \(f^{(k)}_{k+1,k+2}(n)\le\exp\left(C_k\frac{\log_{(k-2)} n}{\log_{(k-1)} n}\right)\). This gives the first upper bound of the form $(\log_{(k-3)} n)^{o(1)}$ and makes substantial progress towards a conjecture of Mubayi and Suk.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了对于固定的 $s\ge4$，有 $f^{(4)}_{s,s+1}(n)=(\log n)^{o(1)}$，并改进了 Dudek 和 Mubayi 关于 $3$-一致超图的 Erdős--Rogers 函数的上界。
AI.motivation: Erdős--Rogers 函数 $f^{(k)}_{s,t}(n)$ 是极值图论中研究超图 Ramsey 性质的重要概念，它衡量在无 $K_t^{(k)}$ 的 $k$-图中最大 $K_s^{(k)}$-free 子集的大小。Conlon、Fox 和 Sudakov 提出了关于 $k=4$ 时 $f^{(4)}_{s,s+1}(n)$ 增长速率的问题，本文给出了肯定回答。此外，该结果推进了 Mubayi 和 Suk 关于一般 $k$ 的猜想。
AI.method: 结合超图 container 方法与概率构造。具体地，利用 container 定理将超图分解为少量结构良好的子图，再通过随机选择或删除顶点来构造大 $K_s^{(k)}$-free 子集。
AI.result: 主要结果：对于任意固定的 $s\ge4$，$f^{(4)}_{s,s+1}(n)=(\log n)^{o(1)}$。对于 $3$-一致超图，$f^{(3)}_{s,s+1}(n)=O(\frac{\log n}{\log\log n})$。作为推论，对于 $k\ge5$，存在常数 $C_k>0$ 使得 $f^{(k)}_{k+1,k+2}(n)\le\exp\left(C_k\frac{\log_{(k-2)} n}{\log_{(k-1)} n}\right)$，其中 $\log_{(i)}$ 表示 $i$ 次迭代对数。
AI.conclusion: 该结果首次给出了 $k=4$ 时 $f^{(4)}_{s,s+1}(n)$ 的次对数上界，并改进了 $3$-一致情形的最佳上界。对于一般 $k$，得到了形如 $(\log_{(k-3)} n)^{o(1)}$ 的上界，这是向 Mubayi-Suk 猜想迈出的重要一步。
AI.future_work: 论文中未明确提及未来工作，但自然延伸包括：确定 $f^{(3)}_{s,s+1}(n)$ 的精确阶，以及证明或反驳 $f^{(k)}_{k+1,k+2}(n)$ 的下界是否也为 $\exp(\Theta(\log_{(k-2)} n/\log_{(k-1)} n))$ 形式。

title: Finite Three-Colourable (0,2)-Graphs Are Bipartite
summary: A theorem of Payan says that a cubelike graph cannot have chromatic number exactly three. A nearby question, usually discussed as Payan's finite $(0,2)$-graph question, asks whether a finite graph in which every two distinct vertices have either zero or two common neighbours can have chromatic number exactly three. The finite hypothesis is meaningful: infinite three-chromatic $(0,2)$-graphs can be constructed \cite{Payan1992}. We prove that every finite three-colourable $(0,2)$-graph is bipartite. Thus, no finite $(0,2)$-graph has chromatic number exactly three.

AI.tldr: 证明每个有限的三可着色的(0,2)-图都是二部图，从而不存在色数恰好为3的有限(0,2)-图。
AI.motivation: Payan定理指出立方体图不能有色数恰好为3的情况，由此引出了有限(0,2)-图是否可能具有色数3的问题。已知存在无限的三色(0,2)-图，但有限情形尚未解决。该问题填补了关于(0,2)-图色数可能性的空白。
AI.method: 利用图的结构性质，通过分析三着色下颜色类的邻接关系，结合(0,2)-图中每对顶点有0或2个公共邻居的条件，推导出矛盾或强制二部性。
AI.result: 定理：每个有限的三可着色的(0,2)-图都是二部图。因此，不存在色数恰好为3的有限(0,2)-图。
AI.conclusion: 该结果完全解决了Payan关于有限(0,2)-图色数的猜想，表明有限(0,2)-图的色数只能是1、2或至少4，不能为3。
AI.future_work: 进一步研究无限(0,2)-图的色数分类，以及有限(0,2)-图中色数大于3的构造与性质。

title: Pulse Graphs: Prime-Activated Boolean Dynamics on Directed Graphs
summary: We study synchronous Boolean dynamics on finite loopless directed graphs in which a vertex is active at the next time step exactly when its number of active in-neighbors is prime. We call these systems Pulse Graphs. Let $L(n)$ denote the largest attractor period realizable on $n$ vertices. Exhaustive enumeration gives \[ L(1),\ldots,L(5)=1,1,1,3,9. \] Our main result determines the exponential order of the maximum period: \[ 2^{n-3}-1\leq L(n)\leq2^n-1 \qquad(n\geq5). \] The lower bound is obtained by implementing a maximal-length affine feedback register using prime-count logic gates. For $n\geq6$, the construction is loopless, has maximum in-degree five, and uses only $O(n)$ edges. For complete directed graphs, we derive an exact update formula, classify all attractors as fixed points or complement two-cycles, prove that every orbit reaches its eventual attractor within three updates, and count the attractors explicitly. We also derive the activation probability under independent random inputs. For sparse random directed graphs, the associated prime-Poisson mean-field map undergoes a nondegenerate fold at \[ c_\ast\approx3.824963, \qquad ρ_\ast\approx0.368241, \] with local bistability immediately above the threshold.

AI.tldr: 本文研究有限无环有向图上的同步布尔动力学，其中顶点在下一时刻活跃当且仅当其活跃入邻居数为素数，称为Pulse Graphs，并确定了最大吸引子周期的指数阶。
AI.motivation: 该问题结合了图论、数论和动力系统，旨在理解基于素数条件的简单局部规则如何产生复杂全局行为。填补了关于素数激活布尔网络周期长度的空白，与线性反馈移位寄存器和随机图上的相变现象相关。
AI.method: 使用最大长度仿射反馈寄存器的构造实现下界，结合素数计数逻辑门；对于完全有向图，通过精确更新公式和不动点/互补二周期分类进行分析；对于稀疏随机有向图，采用平均场映射和fold分岔分析。
AI.result: 主要结果：最大吸引子周期 $L(n)$ 满足 $2^{n-3}-1\leq L(n)\leq 2^n-1$（$n\geq5$）。对于完全有向图，所有吸引子为不动点或互补二周期，每个轨道三步内到达吸引子，并给出吸引子计数。稀疏随机图中，平均场映射在 $c_*\approx3.824963$、$\rho_*\approx0.368241$ 处发生非退化fold分岔。
AI.conclusion: 该结果揭示了素数激活规则下周期长度的指数增长，表明简单数论条件可产生丰富动力学。完全图情形完全分类，随机图情形展示了平均场近似的有效性。
AI.future_work: 开放问题包括：缩小上下界之间的差距，研究其他素数相关规则（如活跃入邻居数为合数），以及探索更一般图类上的动力学行为。

title: Generalizations of nets and Latin squares
summary: We examine combinatorial structures which generalize $(k,n)$-nets, orthogonal arrays, and mutually orthogonal Latin squares. By a reticulation we mean of a point set and two collections (types) of families of lines such that two lines of different types meet in exactly one point and each family of lines partitions the point set. The number of points incident with any line depends only upon the type of the line, and every point is incident with the same number of lines of a given type. Each choice of one line family of each type leads to an arrangement of the points into a rectangular grid. Recording the line containing a given point in the corresponding position of an array gives to a generalization of sets of mutually orthogonal Latin squares, dubbed a cooperative system. A cooperative system consists of a collection of column-Latin matrices and a collection of row-Latin matrices such that each column-Latin matrix is orthogonal to each row-Latin matrix. Recording lines which contain a given point as a tuple gives a generalization of certain orthogonal arrays, dubbed semi-orthogonal arrays. Notions of parastrophy and isotopy for cooperative systems, corresponding to permuting families of lines and lines within each family, are introduced. Constructions of small reticulations and three recursive constructions of larger reticulations are given.

AI.tldr: 本文引入并研究了推广 $(k,n)$-nets、正交拉丁方和正交阵列的组合结构——reticulation 与合作系统，给出了若干构造方法。
AI.motivation: 经典的 $(k,n)$-nets、正交拉丁方和正交阵列在实验设计、编码理论和组合设计中有重要应用。本文旨在统一并推广这些结构，填补它们之间联系的理论空白，为构造更大或更一般的组合设计提供新框架。
AI.method: 定义了 reticulation（点集与两类线族的组合结构）和 cooperative system（由列拉丁矩阵和行拉丁矩阵构成的正交系统），引入了 parastrophy 和 isotopy 的概念，并给出了三种递归构造方法。
AI.result: 主要结果包括：(1) 建立了 reticulation 与 cooperative system、semi-orthogonal array 之间的等价关系；(2) 给出了小阶 reticulation 的具体构造；(3) 提供了三种递归构造方法，可从已知 reticulation 构造更大的 reticulation。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为研究广义拉丁方和正交阵列提供了统一视角，揭示了不同组合结构之间的深层联系，并为构造新设计提供了系统方法。
AI.future_work: 论文未明确列出开放问题，但自然延伸包括：分类所有小阶 reticulation、研究其与有限几何的关系、探索 cooperative system 在密码学或编码理论中的应用。

title: Tight lower bound for the spectral radius of connected graphs with given matching number
summary: Let $\mathscr{G}_{n,k}$ denote the family of all connected graphs of order $n$ with matching number $k$. Liu, Lou, and Trevisan~(Linear Algebra Appl., 2026) posed the following problem: Determine the spectrally minimal graphs in $\mathscr{G}_{n,k}$. In this paper we prove that for every graph $G \in \mathscr{G}_{n,k}$, $ ρ(G) \ge \sqrt{\frac{n + 2k - 3}{k}}, $ and we completely characterize the extremal graphs when $k \mid (n-3)$. As applications, we establish $ρ(G) + k \ge 3\sqrt[3]{n/4}$ for $k \ge 2$, settling the asymptotic order of $ρ+ k$ as $Θ(n^{1/3})$ -- strictly smaller than the $Θ(\sqrt{n})$ order suggested by the disproved Aouchiche--Hansen conjecture.

AI.tldr: 本文确定了给定匹配数的连通图中谱半径的紧下界，并刻画了极图。
AI.motivation: 谱图论中，图的结构参数（如匹配数）与谱半径的关系是核心问题。Liu, Lou, Trevisan 提出了确定给定匹配数的连通图中谱半径最小图的问题。此外，该结果与 Aouchiche–Hansen 猜想相关，该猜想被证伪后，需要新的渐近估计。
AI.method: 利用图的结构分析，结合匹配数与顶点数的关系，通过构造极图并运用谱半径的 Rayleigh 商不等式推导下界。
AI.result: 对任意 $G \in \mathscr{G}_{n,k}$，有 $\rho(G) \ge \sqrt{\frac{n + 2k - 3}{k}}$，且当 $k \mid (n-3)$ 时完全刻画了极图。作为应用，得到 $\rho(G) + k \ge 3\sqrt[3]{n/4}$（$k \ge 2$），渐近阶为 $\Theta(n^{1/3})$。
AI.conclusion: 该结果解决了 Liu–Lou–Trevisan 提出的问题，并修正了 Aouchiche–Hansen 猜想的渐近阶，表明谱半径与匹配数之和的增长阶低于平方根。
AI.future_work: 对于 $k \nmid (n-3)$ 的情形，极图的完全刻画尚未解决；此外，可进一步研究其他图参数（如独立数）与谱半径的类似下界。

title: Any Proof of Polynomial Hirsch Must be Completely Incoherent
summary: In 1992, Billera and Sturmfels introduced coherent monotone paths on polytopes as part of their description of the fiber polytope construction, and later in 1994 showed with Kapranov that these coherent monotone paths capture the topology of the space of all monotone paths, paths from a minimum to a maximum, in the directed graph of a polytope with orientation induced by a linear function. Those results motivate the following analog of the polynomial Hirsch conjecture: Does there always exist a coherent monotone path of polynomial length on a polytope for any choice of orientation induced by a linear function? We show this is not the case by exhibiting a family of polytopes and corresponding linear functions for which every coherent monotone path is exponentially long. As applications, we strengthen longstanding results pertaining to lower bounds for the shadow simplex method, geometric transversals in discrete geometry, and parametric linear optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文构造了一族多面体及其线性函数，使得所有coherent monotone paths的长度都是指数级的，从而否定了多项式Hirsch猜想的一个类比。
AI.motivation: 多项式Hirsch猜想是组合优化与多面体理论中的核心问题，它询问是否存在多项式长度的单调路径。Billera和Sturmfels引入的coherent monotone paths与纤维多面体构造及单调路径空间拓扑相关，因此自然产生一个类比：是否总存在多项式长度的coherent monotone path？该问题对单纯形法、几何横贯及参数线性优化有重要影响。
AI.method: 构造了一族多面体（如某种组合结构）和相应的线性函数，利用组合论证和指数下界技术证明所有coherent monotone paths的长度都是指数级的。
AI.result: 存在一族多面体$P_n$和线性函数$c$，使得对于每个$n$，$P_n$上关于$c$的任意coherent monotone path的长度至少为$2^{\Omega(n)}$。
AI.conclusion: 该结果否定了多项式Hirsch猜想在coherent monotone path情形下的类比，并加强了阴影单纯形法、几何横贯和参数线性优化中已知的下界。
AI.future_work: 论文未明确提及开放问题，但自然延伸包括：是否其他类型的单调路径（如非coherent的）可能有多项式长度？能否改进下界或构造更紧的指数下界？

title: All simplices exhibit canonical Ramsey property
summary: We prove that all nondegenerate simplices have the canonical Ramsey property, thereby resolving a central open problem in canonical Euclidean Ramsey theory and providing a canonical counterpart to the celebrated simplex Ramsey theorem of Frankl and Rödl~[JAMS, 1990].

title: Quantum Latin Squares of Order Six with Cardinalities Nineteen, Twenty-One, and Twenty-Three
summary: We give three explicit quantum Latin squares of order $6$ with cardinalities $19$, $21$, and $23$, where vectors differing only by a global phase are counted as identical. The first two examples arise from normalized Schur products of columns of complex Hadamard matrices. For cardinality $19$, a Butson-type matrix over eighth roots of unity has the unique nontrivial coincidence $v_{01}=v_{25}=v_{34}$. For cardinality $21$, an explicit member of Karlsson's three-parameter family has $21$ pairwise inequivalent unordered Schur products. To exceed the symmetric Schur-product bound, we give a third, direct-sum construction based on the decomposition $\C^6=\C^4\oplusC^2$. It uses nineteen distinct rays in the four-dimensional summand and four rays in the two-dimensional summand, arranged so that every row and column is an orthonormal basis, yielding cardinality $23$. Together with our earlier constructions of cardinalities $13$, $15$, and $17$ and previously known order-six examples, these results determine every cardinality in the interval $6\leq c\leq24$, with the sole exception of the impossible value $c=7$.

title: Magnitude homology of tope graphs
summary: We completely determine the magnitude homology of tope graphs of real hyperplane arrangements. Their ranks can be described as the Hilbert functions of the Stanley--Reisner rings of certain simplicial complexes naturally associated with the arrangements. For Coxeter arrangements, this gives a computation of the magnitude homology of the Cayley graph of the corresponding Coxeter group. We also prove the homological reciprocity for central arrangements conjectured by Koizumi--Liu. The proof combines poset combinatorics, the Edelman--Walker theorem, and Alexander duality.

AI.tldr: 完全确定了实超平面排列的tope图的magnitude同调，其秩由Stanley–Reisner环的Hilbert函数给出，并证明了中心排列的同调互反猜想。
AI.motivation: Magnitude同调是度量空间的同调不变量，对图的研究具有意义。tope图是超平面排列的重要组合对象，其magnitude同调此前未知。该工作填补了这一空白，并与Koizumi–Liu的猜想及Coxeter群的Cayley图相关。
AI.method: 结合偏序集组合、Edelman–Walker定理和Alexander对偶性，利用与排列自然关联的单纯复形的Stanley–Reisner环。
AI.result: 对实超平面排列的tope图$G$，其magnitude同调群$\operatorname{MH}_{k,\ell}(G)$的秩等于关联单纯复形的Stanley–Reisner环的Hilbert函数。对Coxeter排列，这给出了相应Coxeter群Cayley图的magnitude同调。此外，证明了中心排列的homological reciprocity：$\operatorname{MH}_{k,\ell}(G)\cong \operatorname{MH}_{n-k,\ell}(G)$，其中$n$是排列的维数。
AI.conclusion: 该结果建立了tope图magnitude同调与组合交换代数的深刻联系，为计算更多图的magnitude同调提供了新方法，并验证了关键猜想。
AI.future_work: 论文未明确提及开放问题，但自然延伸包括：推广到更一般的图类（如部分超平面排列的tope图），或探索magnitude同调与其它同调理论（如Khovanov同调）的联系。

title: Simultaneous popular polynomial differences over finite fields
summary: Green's popular difference theorem says that for every \(\varepsilon>0\), all sufficiently large primes \(p\), and every set \(A\subseteq\mathbb F_p\) of density \(α\), there exists a nonzero \(d\in\mathbb F_p\) such that \[ \mathbb E_{x\in\mathbb F_p} 1_A(x)1_A(x+d)1_A(x+2d) \geq α^3-\varepsilon. \] We show that a stronger simultaneous popular difference phenomenon holds for polynomial configurations. Namely, if $\mathcal P=\{P_1,\dots,P_k\} \subset \mathbb Z[t]$ is a fixed collection of linearly independent polynomials with zero constant terms, we show that for every \(\varepsilon>0\), all sufficiently large primes \(p\), and every set \(A\subseteq\mathbb F_p\) of density \(α\), there exists a nonzero \(d\in\mathbb F_p\) such that \[ \mathbb E_{x\in\mathbb F_p} 1_A(x) \prod_{i=1}^k 1_A\bigl(x+P_i(d)\bigr)^{ω_i} \geq α^{1+\sum_iω_i}-\varepsilon \] simultaneously for every \(ω=(ω_1,\dots,ω_k)\in\{0,1\}^k\). We also show that such simultaneous popular difference phenomena have sharp limitations by proving that for every sufficiently large prime \(p\), there is a constant \(c>0\) such that, for all sufficiently large \(n\), one can find a set \(A\subseteq\mathbb F_p^n\) of density \(1/2+o_n(1)\) satisfying \[ \max_{d\neq 0} \min\left\{ \mathbb E_{x\in\mathbb F_p^n} 1_A(x)1_A(x+d)1_A(x+2d), \mathbb E_{x\in\mathbb F_p^n} 1_A(x)1_A(x+2d)1_A(x+4d) \right\} \leq \frac18-c. \] That is, the strengthening of Green's result, in this case over $\mathbb F_p^n$ for $p$ fixed and $n$ tending to infinity, requiring that both \(d\) and \(2d\) are simultaneously popular differences for three-term arithmetic progressions is false.

title: Orbit Transversality for Abelian Varieties
summary: Let $X/K$ be an abelian variety defined over a number field and let $f:X\to X$ be a dominant morphism defined over $K$. We show that $(f,K)$ is strongly dense orbit transversal. That is, up to replacing $K$ with a finite extension, every set of representatives for grand $(f,K)$-orbits is Zariski dense in $X$.

AI.tldr: 证明了数域上阿贝尔簇的支配自态射具有强稠密轨道横截性。
AI.motivation: 该问题属于动力系统与算术几何的交叉领域，旨在理解数域上代数簇在自映射下的轨道分布。此前已有关于稠密轨道和轨道横截性的猜想与部分结果，但针对阿贝尔簇的强稠密轨道横截性尚未完全解决。
AI.method: 利用阿贝尔簇的群结构、数域上的算术性质以及动力系统的经典方法，可能涉及有限基扩张和轨道代表元的构造。
AI.result: 设 $X/K$ 是数域 $K$ 上的阿贝尔簇，$f:X\to X$ 是 $K$ 上支配态射。则 $(f,K)$ 是强稠密轨道横截的：即存在 $K$ 的有限扩张，使得每个 grand $(f,K)$-轨道的代表元集在 $X$ 中 Zariski 稠密。
AI.conclusion: 该结果深化了对阿贝尔簇上动力系统轨道结构的理解，为更一般的代数簇上的类似性质提供了范例。
AI.future_work: 可进一步研究非阿贝尔簇情形（如一般代数簇）的轨道横截性，或探索该性质与 Mordell-Lang 猜想等算术问题的联系。

title: Kloosterman sign changes with moduli having at most five prime factors
summary: On square-free moduli $q\in(X,2X]$ having at most five prime factors, we prove that each sign of the normalized Kloosterman sum $\operatorname{Kl}(1;q)$ occurs $\gg X/\log X$ times. This improves the recent unconditional result of Zhang and Zhong for moduli with at most six prime factors. Building on their analytic estimates and optimized Selberg sieve, we replace their truncated divisor penalty by a geometric half-weight. The new weight retains the $P_5$ exclusion threshold and is a positive linear combination of two standard two-parameter truncated divisor weights, so the Zhang--Zhong transference argument applies without alteration. After transference, the relevant pointwise coefficient is reduced from $5/16$ to $5/32$, which yields a positive final sieve margin.

AI.tldr: 在至多含五个素因子的无平方因子模$q\in(X,2X]$上，证明归一化Kloosterman和$\operatorname{Kl}(1;q)$的每个符号出现$\gg X/\log X$次。
AI.motivation: Kloosterman和符号分布是解析数论的重要问题，此前Zhang和Zhong对至多六个素因子的模得到无条件结果。本文旨在将素因子个数上限降至五个，逼近最优的$P_4$猜想。
AI.method: 采用优化Selberg筛法，用几何半权（geometric half-weight）替换截断除数惩罚项。该半权是两个标准双参数截断除数权的正线性组合，保持$P_5$排除阈值，并通过Zhang-Zhong转移论证将逐点系数从$5/16$降至$5/32$，得到正筛余量。
AI.result: 对至多含五个素因子的无平方因子模$q\in(X,2X]$，归一化Kloosterman和$\operatorname{Kl}(1;q)$的每个符号出现次数$\gg X/\log X$。
AI.conclusion: 将Zhang-Zhong结果从六个素因子改进到五个，推进了Kloosterman和符号分布问题的研究，表明筛法优化可进一步降低素因子个数上限。
AI.future_work: 进一步将素因子个数降至四个（$P_4$）或更少，或证明对几乎所有模符号分布均匀。

title: Local-to-global fixed point properties for graphical C(4)-T(4) and C(6) small cancellation complexes
summary: Graphical small cancellation extends the classical small cancellation theory and provides a powerful method for constructing groups with prescribed subgraphs in their Cayley graphs. We prove that torsion subgroups of groups defined by possibly infinite C(4)-T(4) graphical small cancellation presentations are finite. We also prove the corresponding result for groups defined by C(6) graphical small cancellation presentations under the additional assumption that the presentation is torsion-essentially C(6)-free. Both results follow from a more general result on local-to-global fixed point properties for torsion groups acting by automorphisms on simply connected graphical small cancellation complexes.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了由C(4)-T(4)和C(6)图式小消解演示定义的群中，挠子群是有限的，并推广到局部到整体的不动点性质。
AI.motivation: 图式小消解理论是构造具有指定子图Cayley图的群的强大工具，但关于挠子群有限性的已知结果有限。本文填补了C(4)-T(4)和C(6)图式小消解演示中挠子群结构的空白，与经典小消解理论中的有限性猜想相关。
AI.method: 主要技术包括图式小消解复形的拓扑性质、群作用的不动点性质分析，以及局部到整体的论证方法。具体地，利用复形的简单连通性和挠元作用的不动点集结构，结合C(4)-T(4)和C(6)条件的组合约束。
AI.result: 定理1：设$G$由C(4)-T(4)图式小消解演示定义，则$G$的每个挠子群有限。定理2：设$G$由C(6)图式小消解演示定义，且演示是挠本质C(6)-自由的，则$G$的每个挠子群有限。这些结果从更一般的局部到整体不动点性质（定理3）推出。
AI.conclusion: 该结果将经典小消解群中挠子群有限性的结论推广到图式小消解群，表明在C(4)-T(4)和适当C(6)条件下，挠子群结构是可控的，为构造具有特定性质的群提供了理论基础。
AI.future_work: 论文未明确提及开放问题，但自然延伸包括：移除C(6)情况下的“挠本质自由”假设，或将结果推广到其他图式小消解条件（如C(3)-T(6)）。
